nodes.title: Vincent 'Viper' Marcone
nodes.description: Notorious underworld enforcer. Rumored to be coordinating illicit diamond transport through the shipping harbor.

nodes.title: Evelyn Reed
nodes.description: Star chanteuse at The Velvet Room. Possesses intimate knowledge of city hall officials and illicit payoffs.

nodes.title: Silas Thorne
nodes.description: Black-market broker and antiquities dealer. Operates behind a pawnshop facade on 4th Street.

nodes.title: The Velvet Room
nodes.description: Subterranean jazz lounge where shadowy figures, bootleggers, and politicians convene under dim red lights.

nodes.title: Pier 42 Warehouse
nodes.description: Derelict coastal warehouse with rusted cranes. Site of late-night shipping crate transfers without manifest records.

nodes.title: Grand Pacific Vault
nodes.description: Fortified vault deposit where safety box #314 was breached during the thunderstorm of October 14th.

nodes.title: The Blue Star Diamond
nodes.description: A rare 45-carat sapphire-blue diamond, vanished from safety deposit box #314 without tripping perimeter sensors.

nodes.title: The Albatross Ledger
nodes.description: Leather-bound cipher book detailing bribes paid to harbor customs inspectors and precinct captains.

nodes.title: Midnight Drop
nodes.description: Scheduled exchange coordinated via telegraph codes for 02:00 hours at low tide under the fog.

nodes.title: Cyanide Vials
nodes.description: Pharmaceutical glass ampoules labeled 'Reagent B' discovered behind the condenser coils at Pier 42.

threads.title: The Vault Infiltration Syndicate
threads.description: Connecting the inside man, fencing operative, breached vault, and stolen gem.

threads.title: Speakeasy Payoff Channel
threads.description: Evelyn Reed acts as courier exchanging ledger codes with informants in the back booths.

threads.title: Pier 42 Midnight Poison Protocol
threads.description: Viper Marcone staged the midnight drop at Pier 42 with cyanide vials prepared in case of police intervention.

threads.title: Blackmail Over the Cipher Ledger
threads.description: Thorne attempted to blackmail Evelyn using pages stolen from the Albatross Ledger.
